design.fallback: Surface agreement is conditional on reliable, unoccluded predicted depth; unknown depth is not evidence of disagreement. Require the same absolute minimum support, registration confidence, ambiguity and free-space checks.
design.fusion: Uncertainty weighting constrained by visual reliability; high-confidence observations receive a small correction while low-confidence observations can use CAD.
design.scale_interpretation: External heuristic uncertainty estimates; not calibrated model probabilities.
design.physical_evaluation: Both arms use the same corrected unique-voxel GraspGen interface; no comparison to the legacy baseline.
design.change_from_v4: Multiply the variance-derived CAD correction by (1-q_v). The CAD weight is at most min(alpha_max,1-q_v); q_v=1 observations stay fixed. Keep confidence maps, registration, completion, visibility and fallback unchanged.
design.change_from_v5: Retain thin CAD surface samples above 0.25 mm in hypothesis scoring and completion; shared RGB foreground visual preprocessing is independent of CAD.
